_note: Deploy values only. Program id comes from the IDL (target/idl/safu_pool.json `address`); every rule number comes from the IDL constants. `usdcMint`: Circle's USDC on this cluster (classic SPL Token, 6 decimals; `initialize` refuses anything else). `poolCapUsdc`: USDC base units, same cap as the Stellar pool ($100,000). `siteRpcPath`: the deployed site reads the chain through the claim API (/rpc, server-side provider failover); `rpcUrl` is for tools and local dev. `stellarForwarder`: Circle's CctpForwarder contract on Stellar for this cluster (testnet for devnet/localnet; mainnet CBZL2IH7F6BIDAA3WBNXYKIXSATJGMSW7K5P5MJ6STX5RXN47TZJDF5T), from developers.circle.com/cctp/references/stellar-contracts. `irisUrl`: Circle's attestation API for this cluster (sandbox for devnet/localnet; mainnet https://iris-api.circle.com/v2/messages); the CCTP relayer appends /<source domain>. `relayLookupTable` (set once created by `python -m backend.solana_relay lookup-table`): the relayer's address lookup table. `maxComputeUnitPrice`: the highest priority fee a transaction from the backend or the site pays, micro-lamports per compute unit (the recent fee level, capped here).
